_meta.schema: Report §9 field set (name, country, genre[], streamUrl, logoUrl, description, isActive, verificationStatus, streamCheck, rightToStream, stationContactStatus, createdAt, updatedAt)
_meta.rights_model: Four rights states tracked separately and honestly: (1) streamDiscovered, (2) streamCheck.status=ok == technically verified, (3) stationContactStatus, (4) rightToStream. A working public stream URL is NOT permission.
_meta.invariant: isActive:true requires verificationStatus=='verified' AND streamCheck.status=='ok' AND rightToStream!='denied'. Necessary, not sufficient — isActive may still be false for other reasons (e.g. HTTP-only/mixed-content).
_meta.verification_method: curl GET, confirmed HTTP 200 + audio/* content-type live bytes for each streamUrl
_meta.stack_note: These 5 stations ALSO already ship in the live Next.js static MVP (src/lib/stations/catalog.ts, island-waves-radio.surge.sh). This file is the Firestore-shaped projection per BRE-39 §9. Confirm target backend (Firestore vs. Next.js static) before import — see BRE-39 escalation to CEO.
